proposed_canonical_wording: Topic creation acknowledgment is not proof of metadata visibility. Following successful topic creation, or the supported duplicate-creator response40002, read back the exact expected topic metadata and configuration before provisioning succeeds. Both paths and an already-existing topic use the same partition-count, delete-only cleanup and effective-retention validation;40002 must never bypass these checks.

Only a404 from the exact expected topic metadata/configuration read, after successful creation or40002, is classified as transient creation visibility. Retry those read-only readiness checks at a fixed bounded50ms delay. Do not repeat creation merely because a read is not yet visible. Authentication/authorization errors, other non2xx responses including500, malformed metadata, wrong topology or cleanup/configuration mismatch retain failure behavior; never retry a mismatch into acceptance.

Establish one absolute monotonic provisioning deadline before its first resource admission, bounded by the effective eventing timeout and any already-accepted owning operation deadline. Cluster discovery, existence/create requests, resource queue waits, readiness reads and delay all consume that same budget. Before every admission compute positive remaining time and pass only that remaining budget through the resource scheduler to the HTTP operation. A404 cannot reset it. A delay holds no active HTTP ticket, and no request starts after expiration.

On expiration or nontransient failure, preserve existing typed failure/cancellation semantics. Recovery must not record a durable decision, select a route, alter old-topic retention or admit staged data. Any created unused topic is an external predecision side effect, as already documented. Do not reopen the owning accepted deadline.

Fresh recovery still verifies beginning_offset==0 and end_offset==0 after metadata readiness. A200 with nonempty, negative, missing or malformed offsets must fail; metadata readiness is not permission to consume an old tail. No widened retry of offsets or weaker emptiness validation is proposed.
minimal_runtime_design: Refactor the duplicate existing/new branches in Eventing.provision into one metadata/config validator. Classify create success,40002 and existing success explicitly; preserve existing apply_retention=false predecision behavior and true postdecision/normal-worker semantics.

For new/duplicate creation, an await_topic_ready helper reads metadata/configs and retries only the specified404. Validate positive successful bodies immediately; do not route mismatch through the transient branch. Keep create response topology validation too.

Add a private request-until helper accepting the absolute deadline. Compute remaining before Resources.run(:eventing,remaining,...); callback receives scheduler-reduced remaining and request_now uses no more than that remainder for connect/response/cancellation. Existing ordinary request API can delegate with its existing single-request deadline.

Use one provisioning deadline for discovery through readiness, not a fresh timeout per physical request/retry. Pass the immutable accepted job.limits.deadline_ms from ProjectRestore.prepare_apply to Eventing fresh-topic preflight (via explicit argument/private helper); Config preflight/worker callers use their existing available operation bound, otherwise effective eventing timeout.

Preserve existing scope/configuration revision fences, HTTP request registration and resource cleanup. This is a product authority/runtime successor, not a fixture retry, timeout extension, health warmup or source patch under final05 identity.
